title: Serve crawl rules, a sitemap, and Open Graph images
preconditions: The local app is running with NEXTAUTH_URL set to the local origin.

steps.expected: The file allows crawling, disallows /admin, /admin/*, and /api/*, and points at the sitemap.
The sitemap lists the home, experiences, questions, and about routes with absolute local URLs.
Both return a raster image with an image content type.

risk: Read-only. Do not simulate a crawler against gated routes in this check.
